heading: Chicago USCIS medical exam comparison: speed, packet timing, and vaccine handling
i693_document_requirements: Bring ID, immigration forms, and any prior vaccine documentation so the office can screen for missing items quickly.
vaccination_handling_notes: Chicago comparisons often turn on whether vaccine gaps can be solved onsite or require outside appointments.
bilingual_support: If you need translated instructions, confirm support before the visit so paperwork review does not become the bottleneck.
appointment_booking_notes: Ask the office to explain the process step-by-step instead of relying on same-week language alone.
Booking flow: verify USCIS designation, ask total cost, confirm documents/vaccine records, schedule exam, complete labs/vaccines, then pick up sealed packet after final review.
